ns2:section.sectionText: This Discovery course will provide a survey of how the legal system has been used to attempt to address domestic violence. Some of the topics that will be covered include: the distinction between the civil and criminal justice system; the role of lawyers and prosecutors; and how domestic violence impacts family law, employment law, housing and poverty. The teaching methodologies will include discussion, videos, role playing, and presentations of real problems investigated by the students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
